scope: Source interpretation only; this file grants no result-read or model authority. Bind all three finalized scored inputs and preregister the actual read before invocation.

declared_labels.promising_system: Knowledge-minus-direct primary lower bound exceeds the predeclared headroom threshold under natural and equal-tier weighting. Require nonnegative official tool-accuracy and macro parameter-F1 point differences; these latter checks do not establish noninferiority.
declared_labels.knowledge_contribution: The corresponding knowledge-minus-stage-control primary lower bound exceeds its predeclared threshold under natural and equal-tier weighting.
declared_labels.adoption: Same-roster full comparison reproduction required before claiming a newly effective mechanism.
declared_labels.negative_or_uncertain: Report each comparison separately; no positive memory rule or new roster is inferred. Name a component from predeclared traces before another mechanism is admitted.

rule_clarifications: The promising_system label does not require the knowledge-minus-stage-control contrast to pass.
The frozen declaration attaches tool-accuracy and macro parameter-F1 point guards to promising_system, not to knowledge_contribution.
Report every declared native/equal-tier result and guard point; do not relabel a point guard as noninferiority.
Apply any additional conservative root interpretation separately; do not attribute it to the frozen rule.
